notes.title: Launched!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32939445/1504a4f3fabf7edcaf2c1419c300f4a93dec5371.gif
Box: The Game has officially launched with a 10% discount.

I hope you will enjoy the game, if you have any feedback please let me know, either here, as a review or in the Discord.

If you have any questions, feel free to ask!

Join the Discord here:
http://heekdevelopment.com/discord

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content:
Demo Update
The demo has been updated to a more recent version of the game, you can now compete with other people for the first 5 levels on the leaderboards.

Music has also been added to the demo.

notes.title: Development update #2
notes.content:
Leaderboards
Leaderboards have been added to the game, this means that you can challenge your friends to try to complete the game in less moves, here an in development version of it currently looks:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32939445/be3701b04002f745b5fb2619c771e88c92acac5e.png

Community
The Discord community has been growing steadily, if you want to join use this link:
https://discord.gg/XDQjr53

notes.title: Development update #1
notes.content:
Community
A community is important to a game, if you want to talk about the game, talk about ideas you have for the game or just want to chat with fellow gamers, you can join the Discord.

Music
Music has been added to the game, I have chosen for classical music, this seems to be fitting the game really well.

Almost All Levels
Almost all levels have been created, currently 42 out of the 50 levels have been completed! Here is a picture of the 40th level:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32939445/80823d52396186006837fc44a6ffbd3faf40af8b.png

Kickstarter
A Kickstarter has been created for the game, do not worry, no matter the outcome the game will be released, here is the link:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/mrgoatsy/box-the-game

notes.title: The Demo is available now!
notes.content:
Demo
The demo for Box: The Game is available now, it contains 5 levels to try out, it also has a colour blind mode because everybody deserves a chance to have fun!

Update
At the moment 30 levels have been completed for the full game, here is a screenshot of level 30:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32939445/e604d7d42a27ef07ea17990911150b9471892ac0.png

Release date
The release date is not yet known but it is planned to somewhere in Q4 2018 or early Q1 2019.
